paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and the BLEU score for consistency, wait-1, and inconsistency, wait-9. The x-axis represents the number of tokens for the gold prefix, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick labels spaced approximately every 5 tokens. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, measured in units of ‘LEU’ and displayed on a linear scale from 23 to 28. The ‘Consistency: wait-1’ line is depicted as a dashed blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 25.5 and decreasing over the x-axis to approximately 26.8 at the end. The ‘Inconsistency: wait-9’ line is shown as a red line with square markers, beginning at approximately 25.25 and increasing to approximately 26.6 over the x-axis.
